shadow:
Some dreams feel like progress and are not. They play in the mind, the better life, the right person, the version of things where the ache has finally stopped.

The trouble is what the warmth does. It pays out a small reward just for picturing the thing, and once the picture pays, the foot never leaves the ground. The dream becomes the destination. You can spend years like this, fed by hope, going nowhere, and not notice, because hoping feels close enough to moving.

Underneath it runs a hunger that swings. Empty, and the mind reaches for the fantasy of full. Full, and it sinks under the weight of what was.

Most people read this as a failure of willpower and try to dream harder, or smaller. That misses it. The pull itself is not the fault. It is real evolutionary pressure, the body pushing to begin something. The dream is that pressure mistranslated. Read the instruction correctly and the same charge stops feeding the picture and starts feeding a first step. The wanting was always pointed at a door. It just kept describing the door instead of opening it.
repressive: Some people retreat all the way inside the dream and stop coming back. The inner world is softer than this one, so they live there, and the relationships and the body slowly thin from being left untended.
reactive: Others are pure forward motion, sprinting on the fuel of the vision, always a little ahead of themselves. The dream outruns what the day can carry, the nervous system frays, and the crash, when it lands, takes others down with it.
gift:
Stop mistaking the dream for the arrival and a different question opens, what is the dream actually reaching for. Sit with any fantasy long enough and a plainer hunger shows underneath it. Not the money, not the perfect partner, not the escape. A wish to be filled, to merge with something larger, to stop standing apart.

That seeing is anticipation. It traces the charge back to its root and lets the energy travel where it was always headed, upward, into something usable.

And because this gift reads its own dreams clearly, it reads the field around it the same way. It catches the direction a thing wants to move before the thing announces itself. Where a person is stuck in a loop, anticipation senses the place the loop could break and the moment it could break there. This is why such people end up trusted to lead, and why they tell good stories. A story is anticipation made shareable. It carries a listener toward an ending they can already half feel.

The genius is not in dreaming the thing. It is in catching the thing as it forms and getting it down before it fades.
siddhi:
Follow the trail back far enough and every dream a person ever had turns out to be one dream wearing many faces. The wish for more, the wish to be loved, the wish for it to finally be enough. All of it was the same pull, the pull back toward the source it came from.

Emanation is what is left when the seeking arrives. Everything here pours out of one beginning and is quietly on its way home to it. The story and its ending were never two things. The end was folded into the first word.

From here there is no more hunger, because there is nothing missing to hunger for. The pressure to evolve, to get somewhere, simply lifts.

And the fantasy at the very start, the one that looked like avoidance, was not avoidance. It was the first faint signal of this, the pull already working, already aiming the whole life back at the place it began. The dreamer was being called the entire time. They just could not yet hear where from.
